subject: telerally
title: What is a telerally: Trump's tele-rallies before the midterms
answer: A telerally is a rally held by phone or video rather than in person, in which a political figure speaks to supporters and voters from a distance. Before the Nov. 3, 2026 midterm elections, the Republican National Committee planned Trump telerallies aimed at nearly 20 states.
body:
A telerally (also written tele-rally, plural telerallies) lets one speaker reach voters in many states at once, with no travel, crowd or venue. Supporters listen in by phone or online instead of standing in an arena.

Trump had used the format before. In late October 2025 he spoke at a telerally for Jack Ciattarelli, the Republican candidate for governor of New Jersey, and on Nov. 3, 2025 he held one for Winsome Earle-Sears in Virginia.

On Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026, the RNC said it would replace planned in-person stops in Iowa and Kansas with a "72-hour sprint" of telerallies across nearly 20 states, including Michigan, Alaska, Texas and Iowa. Party chairman Joe Gruters argued that virtual events reach more voters than single stops. Asked why he was skipping Kansas, Trump said, "I don't feel I have to go to Kansas."

The plan changed a day later. On Oct. 30 the Iowa and Kansas rallies were put back on the schedule, and on Sunday, Nov. 1, Trump spoke in person in Dubuque, Iowa, and Salina, Kansas, two days before the vote.
in_the_news: The word spread after the RNC swapped two of Trump's final midterm rallies for telerallies on Oct. 29, 2026. The in-person rallies were restored a day later and held on Nov. 1.

faq.a: It is a campaign rally held over the phone or online. The candidate speaks and supporters listen remotely instead of gathering in one place.
Telerallies is the plural. A campaign can hold several in a few days to reach voters in many states without traveling.

faq.q: Has Trump done a telerally before?
faq.a: Yes. In 2025 he spoke at telerallies for Republican governor candidates in New Jersey and Virginia.

faq.q: Did Trump cancel his Iowa and Kansas rallies?
faq.a: Only briefly. They were dropped on Oct. 29, 2026, restored on Oct. 30, and held in person in Dubuque and Salina on Nov. 1.
